purpose: Teach: 水路/電線/イスラーム/清浄/農法/明瞭/新約/精製

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療廃水の水路、つまり水路処理を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team manages the waterways for medical wastewater — the channel treatment itself.
lines.style: Calm clinical opening, seated and unhurried. Clear, even stresses with quiet bedside warmth.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、電線、つまり電線事故の感電症例を医療チームで対応します
lines.en: The team also handles electrocution cases from power-line accidents.
lines.style: Steady continuation, slightly graver tone on the injuries. No drama, pure clean competence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、イスラーム、つまりイスラーム圏の患者様への医療配慮を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: We make careful accommodations for patients from the Islamic world — the whole team does.
lines.style: Softening noticeably, slower on the word careful. Genuine consideration warms the clinical register.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、清浄、つまり清浄病室の管理を医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: We are rigorous about managing the clean wards — keeping those rooms truly sterile.
lines.style: Firm, precise delivery with a slight forward lean. The rigor stated as simple fact.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、有機農法、つまり農法食材の医療食を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: We also provide hospital meals made with organically farmed ingredients.
lines.style: Lighter, almost pleased note here. A small smile behind the pace, still professional.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、症状を明瞭に医療チームで記録します
lines.en: And we record every symptom clearly — unambiguously — as a team.
lines.style: Deliberate slowing for emphasis, each word placed. Teaching cadence, kind but exact.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新約聖書を慰めとされる患者様にも医療チームで配慮します
lines.en: We are considerate, too, of patients who find comfort in the New Testament.
lines.style: Quietest line of the set, gentle and unhurried. Compassion allowed briefly to the surface.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医薬品の精製、つまり精製度を医療チームで確認します
lines.en: And we verify the refinement of every medication — its purity grade — ourselves.
lines.style: Composed, conclusive close. Slightly lower pitch, the final assurance offered like a handshake.
